Scout Overview: Sitetracker’s Agentic AI Explained 
Sitetracker is your system of record. Scout is your system of action — agentic AI that connects directly to Sitetracker and your other systems to automate workflows and answer questions in natural language. It uses Compass, its contextual engine, to deliver accurate, hallucination-free answers, while Skills handle repeatable tasks and the Agent Builder lets you create specialist agents that run on demand, on schedule, or fully automated — using your preferred LLM or Scout’s auto-selected model. Full observability through Watch keeps every execution in view. Together, Sitetracker and Scout close the gap between insight and execution for infrastructure teams.
